caterpie-bug-buzz.name: Bug Buzz
caterpie-bug-buzz.description: Bond skill: a damaging buzz of its wings at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 95).

caterpie-harden.name: Harden
caterpie-harden.description: Bond skill: hardens its shell; it is Protected for 1 turn.

caterpie-quiver-dance.name: Quiver Dance
caterpie-quiver-dance.description: Bond skill: a light, mystic dance; it is Hasted for 2 turns and Focused for 1.

caterpie-compound-eyes.name: Compound Eyes
caterpie-compound-eyes.description: Its keen eyes aim true: deals 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

caterpie-hungry-caterpillar.name: Hungry Caterpillar
caterpie-hungry-caterpillar.description: Never stops eating: heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

caterpie-sleep-powder.name: Sleep Powder
caterpie-sleep-powder.description: New skill: a powder that puts a foe up to 2 hexes away to Sleep for 2 turns.

caterpie-psybeam.name: Psybeam
caterpie-psybeam.description: New skill: a peculiar ray at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60).

caterpie-poison-scales.name: Shield Dust
caterpie-poison-scales.description: Its scales block harmful effects: cannot be Poisoned, Burned or Paralyzed.

caterpie-silk-cocoon.name: Silk Cocoon
caterpie-silk-cocoon.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

caterpie-air-slash.name: Air Slash
caterpie-air-slash.description: New skill: a blade of air at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70).

caterpie-poison-powder.name: Poison Powder
caterpie-poison-powder.description: New skill: toxic powder on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 40), Poisoning for 2 turns.

caterpie-fluttering-wings.name: Fluttering Wings
caterpie-fluttering-wings.description: Flutters off: steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

caterpie-silver-scales.name: Silver Scales
caterpie-silver-scales.description: Its Bug moves deal 15% more damage.

caterpie-hurricane.name: Hurricane
caterpie-hurricane.description: New skill: a howling gale at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90) that pushes it 1 hex.

caterpie-gentle-flutter.name: Gentle Flutter
caterpie-gentle-flutter.description: Hard to pin down in flight: takes 10% less damage.

caterpie-dust-cloud.name: Dust Cloud
caterpie-dust-cloud.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer; +15% damage to foes with a status an ally applied.

caterpie-silver-wind.name: Silver Wind
caterpie-silver-wind.description: New skill: a gust of silvery scales on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 90).

caterpie-u-turn.name: U-turn
caterpie-u-turn.description: New skill: hits a foe (Power 70), then darts free of engagement.

caterpie-metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
caterpie-metamorphosis.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

caterpie-pollen-trail.name: Pollen Trail
caterpie-pollen-trail.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes with any status.

caterpie-vivid-monarch.name: Vivid Monarch
caterpie-vivid-monarch.description: Capstone. Its Flying and Psychic moves deal 15% more damage; its non-damaging skills recharge 1 turn faster.

caterpie-dream-dust.name: Dream Dust
caterpie-dream-dust.description: Capstone. Deals 25% more damage to Sleeping, Poisoned or Paralysed foes.

caterpie-supersonic.name: Supersonic
caterpie-supersonic.description: New skill: odd sound waves at a foe up to 2 hexes away: Confused for 2 turns.
